name: legitimate_inactivity__teleop
regression: Legitimate inactivity: an event topic that ends on a zero command and stays silent is not stale telemetry and not a stale command.
initial_conditions: Synthetic GO2 + HELIX run (6.5 s): /nav/cmd_vel at 20 Hz commands 0 m/s, then 0.15 m/s from t=2 s; HELIX hold published at 10 Hz, never asserted; odometry and lowstate at 20 Hz from the robot host, whose clock is 1.734 s ahead of the payload.
injected_fault: An operator drives at 0.1 m/s from t=0.5 to 1.5 s, releases the stick (one zero twist) and is silent for the rest of the run.
